January Special Meeting of Council

Tuesday, January 10, 2023 - 07:00 PM

In accordance with section 5.4 of the Local Government Act 1995, a Special Meeting of Council has been called by the President.


The Special Meeting of Council will be held on Tuesday 10 January 2023 at 7.00pm in the Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon.


The PURPOSE of the meeting is to consider the following:

  • SCM01 - 01/23 - CONFIDENTIAL ITEM: Appointment of Chief Executive Officer

Minutes

SCM PUBLIC MINUTES UNCONFIRMED _ 100123 (502.66 KB)

We acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land within the Shire of Chittering, the Yued and Whadjuk peoples. We would like to pay respect to the Elders of the Nyoongar nation, past and present, who have walked and cared for the land, we acknowledge and respect their continuing culture, and the contributions made to this region.

Notice is hereby given that the next Ordinary meeting of the Shire of Chittering will be held on Wednesday 16 February 2022 at the Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon commencing at 7.00pm.

June Special Meeting of Council

Wednesday, June 29, 2022 - 06:00 PM

In accordance with section 5.4 of the Local Government Act 1995, a Special Meeting of Council has been called by the President.


The Special Meeting of Council will be held on Wednesday 29 June 2022 at 6.00pm in the Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon.


The PURPOSE of the meeting is to consider the following:

  • SCM01 - 06/22 - Adoption of the 2022-23 Annual Budget

We acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land within the Shire of Chittering, the Yued and Whadjuk peoples. We would like to pay respect to the Elders of the Nyoongar nation, past and present, who have walked and cared for the land, we acknowledge and respect their continuing culture, and the contributions made to this region.

June Special Meeting of Council

Wednesday, June 23, 2021 - 06:00 PM

In accordance with section 5.4 of the Local Government Act 1995, a Special Meeting of Council has been called by the President.


The Special Meeting of Council will be held on Wednesday 23 June 2021 at 6.00pm in the Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon.


The PURPOSE of the meeting is to consider the following:

  • SCM01 - 06/21 - Adoption of the 2021-22 Annual Budget
  • SCM02 - 06/21 - Adoption of the 2021-2031 Long Term Financial Plan and Corporate Business Plan

Minutes

SCM MINUTES CONFIRMED _ 230621 (488.56 KB)

Document

SCM ATTACHMENTS (2.91 MB)

Agenda

SCM AGENDA _ 230621 (426.22 KB)

We acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land within the Shire of Chittering, the Yued and Whadjuk peoples. We would like to pay respect to the Elders of the Nyoongar nation, past and present, who have walked and cared for the land, we acknowledge and respect their continuing culture, and the contributions made to this region.

Notice is hereby given that the next Ordinary meeting of the Shire of Chittering will be held on Wednesday, 19 February 2020 in the Council Chambers, Bindoon commencing at 7.00pm.

The initial Special Meeting of Council was held on Wednesday 22 July 2020 and was adjourned at 6.45pm.

The meeting is scheduled to reconvene at 6pm on Wednesday 29 July 2020.

The purpose of the meeting is to Adopt of the 2020/2021 Annual Budget.

This meeting will be held in the Shire of Chittering’s Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon.

The meeting is open to the public – all participants are expected to abide by the current COVID-19 safety, hygiene and social distancing guidelines.  To find out more information on the latest information, visit https://www.wa.gov.au/government/publications/phase-4-easing-of-restrictions-frequently-asked-questions

Further information is available by contact Council Support at eso@chittering.wa.gov.au or on 9576 4600.

July Special Meeting of Council

Wednesday, July 1, 2020 - 06:00 PM

In accordance with the Local Government Act 1995, S5.4 notice is hereby given that a Special Meeting of Council will be held on Wednesday 1 July 2020 commencing at 6.00pm.

The meeting will be held in the Shire of Chittering’s Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon.

The purpose of this Special Meeting is to consider SAT DR 109/2020: NBN Co Ltd v Shire of Chittering.

The meeting is open to the public – all participants are expected to abide by the current COVID-19 safety, hygiene and social distancing guidelines.

Further information is available by contact Council Support at eso@chittering.wa.gov.au or on 9576 4600.

The purpose of the meeting is to:

  1. Elect Shire President
  2. Elect Deputy President
  3. Local Government Extraordinary Election 2021

For more information, please contact Council Support on 9576 4606 or email chatter@chittering.wa.gov.au

September Special Meeting of Council

Monday, September 14, 2020 - 07:00 PM

In accordance with section 5.4 of the Local Government Act 1995, a Special Meeting of Council has been called by at least one third of Councillors.

The Special Meeting of Council will be held on Monday 14 September 2020 at 7.00pm in the Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon.

The PURPOSE of the meeting is to consider:

  1. Addressing an Action Affecting an Employee
  2. Addressing an Action Relating to an Employee

Please note matters 1 and 2 will be closed to members of the public in accordance with 5.23 of the Local Government Act 1995 as it is:

(a)  a matter affecting an employee or employees.

Further information is available by contact Council Support at natasha.mossman@chittering.wa.gov.au or on 9576 4606.

Special Meeting of Council (Reconvene)

Wednesday, July 29, 2020 - 06:00 PM

The initial Special Meeting of Council was held on Wednesday 22 July 2020 and was adjourned at 6.45pm.

The meeting is scheduled to reconvene at 6pm on Wednesday 29 July 2020.

The purpose of the meeting is to Adopt the 2020/2021 Annual Budget.

This meeting will be held in the Shire of Chittering’s Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon.

The meeting is open to the public – all participants are expected to abide by the current COVID-19 safety, hygiene and social distancing guidelines.  To find out more information on the latest information, visit https://www.wa.gov.au/government/publications/phase-4-easing-of-restrictions-frequently-asked-questions

Further information is available by contact Council Support at eso@chittering.wa.gov.au or on 9576 4600.

Special Council Meeting Attachments (2.46 MB)

We acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land within the Shire of Chittering, the Yued and Whadjuk peoples. We would like to pay respect to the Elders of the Nyoongar nation, past and present, who have walked and cared for the land, we acknowledge and respect their continuing culture, and the contributions made to this region.

Council Meetings

Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third Wednesday of the months February through to December. The meetings are held in the Council Chambers, 6177 Great Northern Highway, Bindoon, commencing at 7pm (unless otherwise advised).

No action should be taken on any item discussed at a Council meeting prior to written advice on the resolution of Council being received.

Rate payers and residents are welcome to attend these meetings.

Further information can be obtained by contacting the Shire's Council Support Officer on (08) 9576 4600.

Agendas

Agendas for Council meetings are available to Elected Members and the public on the Friday prior to the Council meeting; and can be obtained from the Bindoon Library, the Shire's Administration Centre, or downloaded below.

Limited copies are available at the meeting.

Minutes

The Shire website contains minutes from Council and Annual Electors meetings from 2012.  If you wish to view Council Minutes that are not available on this site please visit the Shire's Administration Office Monday-Friday between 8.30am and 4pm.

Live stream of Council meetings

To access a live stream of previous Council Proceedings, please click below.  A live stream will commence at 7pm (AWST) on the evening of the scheduled Ordinary Council Meeting.
